title: fix(objectql): an update's multi-value wrap and first value check run on the payload left after the read-only strips
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:更新(update)路径的多值整理与首轮值校验,改为在两道只读剥离之后、对剩下的载荷进行;按 id 与批量两条路径一致,与插入路径的顺序相同。
- 为什么改:多值整理与首轮值校验只作用于只读剥离之后剩下的载荷,与插入路径对齐。
- 风险与回滚:任一道只读剥离移除的字段上的畸形值,现在被剥离并经 `onFieldsDropped` 报告(strict 模式下拒绝),不再整单 `VALIDATION_FAILED`;可写字段的校验不变;update 模式的校验预览对这类字段可能比更新本身更严(安全方向)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`(`judgeStrippedPayload` 与 `inStoredMultiValueShape` 两个闭包,及两条路径的调用点);`packages/objectql/src/engine-update-multi-value-after-strip.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/engine-update-multi-value-after-strip.test.ts`,预期 13 个用例全部通过。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`ObjectQL.update` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-update.ts`) now follows the insert path's order on both the by-id branch and the bulk (predicate) branch. First come the two read-only strips (`readonlyWhen`, then static `readonly`). Then come the multi-value wrap (`normalizeMultiValueFields`, scope `'skip'`) and the first `validateRecord` pass. Both run in one closure, `judgeStrippedPayload`, which each branch calls right after its strips. The rule this diff holds: the multi-value wrap and the first value check run on the payload left after the read-only strips.

`readonlyWhen` predicates still read multi-valued fields in their stored list form. Each strip's `stored` view goes through `inStoredMultiValueShape`, which wraps a copy and never the payload, so `record` stays "the payload the write stores" (#19887). The second pass (`validateRecordInScope(…, 'only')` for readonly values) is unchanged.

One changeset: `@objectstack/objectql` patch.

## Tests

New file: `packages/objectql/src/engine-update-multi-value-after-strip.test.ts`. It runs the real engine against an in-memory driver and has 13 cases:

- by id and bulk: a locked multi-valued field (`multiselect`, and `select` with `multiple: true`) keeps its stored value, whatever form the caller writes it in. `onFieldsDropped` reports it under `readonly_when`.
- by id and bulk: a value the lock removes is not judged, and the update stores what is left.
- by id and bulk, under `strictReadonlyWrites`: such a value is refused as a read-only write (`ERR_READONLY_FIELD_REJECTED`), and nothing is written.
- CONTROLS for the paths this change leaves alone:
  - an unlocked multi-valued field still stores a single value in its list form (by id and bulk);
  - a hook-written value on a locked field is still the server's and is stored in list form;
  - a value that is not a list at all is still refused on an unlocked field with `VALIDATION_FAILED` / `invalid_type`;
  - a lock whose predicate reads a multi-valued field still reads it in list form.

## Acceptance notes

- What callers see, in the changeset: a malformed value on a field that either read-only strip removes used to fail the update with `VALIDATION_FAILED`. It is now dropped and reported (or refused under `strictReadonlyWrites`). Writable fields are judged exactly as before.
- Also in the changeset: for such a field, an update-mode validation preview can now refuse a row the update accepts. That is the safe direction. No spec edit is in this PR.
- No open PR touches `engine-update.ts` or `validation/rule-validator.ts`. I checked all 30 open PRs at the time of writing.

## Verification

<details><summary>Rule tests before and after, and ablation</summary>

- Origin/main, before the fix: `Tests 2 failed | 6 passed (8)` on the first version of the file. Every control was green.
- With the fix: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
- Ablation 1: I restored `engine-update.ts` to its base blob (on-disk hash compared). Result: `Tests 3 failed | 7 passed (10)`, red on the two rule cases and the not-judged case. Restored to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2 (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`): I dropped the wrap inside `inStoredMultiValueShape`. Result: `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`, red on the predicate-view control. Restored to the HEAD blob, with `git diff HEAD` empty.

</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test` on 126f932d67: `Test Files 596 passed (596)`, `Tests 12952 passed (12952)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` on 126f932d67: `tsc --noEmit` clean, `check:test-typecheck: OK` (ledger unchanged).
- The new file on 126f932d67: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.
